title: vidtoolz.resolveProductionReadAuthority.v1
description: Human-governed source record authorizing the nine read-only Resolve operations against explicitly listed production Disk libraries/projects per host. Compiled deterministically into vidtoolz.resolveProductionReadRuntimePolicy.v1 by tools/compile_production_read_policy.py, which enforces this schema natively (closed objects, exact enums/patterns) before anything else. A LIVE (permissive) policy is produced ONLY from status ACCEPTED with a valid human approver, approval date, acceptance-record reference, exact worker/facade pins and a non-empty host/library/project grant; every other record compiles only with --preview into a non-live deny-all artifact the worker refuses to serve. Deny by default; no wildcards; Disk libraries only in v1 (network libraries deferred).

approved_by.description: null until a human accepts; otherwise the allowlisted approver recorded by repository convention (adjudications/*ACCEPTANCE.json decided_by)

acceptance_record.description: path of the governance acceptance record that carries the human decision

worker_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact production-read worker file this grant is for; the worker compares it with its own bytes at every operation

commit.description: accepted Hermes facade commit; the worker refuses a policy naming any other facade

registration_root.description: verbatim root field of the host's Resolve registration line (.dblist on Linux, dblist.conf on Windows, where the drive colon is absent)

canonical_root.description: canonical physical root: realpath of the registered root (Windows: normcase of the final path). The worker resolves the registered root at every operation and refuses unless it canonicalizes to exactly this value.

physical_dev.description: optional extra pin: st_dev (Windows: volume serial) of the physical root

physical_ino.description: optional extra pin: st_ino (Windows: file index) of the physical root

project_open_law.const: read the project the human already opened; never LoadProject/OpenProject/SetCurrentProject/SetCurrentDatabase

network_libraries.const: DEFERRED — not authorized by v1 (EKA, nelja)
